staticPages.aboutSeoTitle: About Rate.vn - Spec, price and review comparison | Rate.vn
staticPages.aboutSeoDesc: How Rate.vn standardizes 10 spec groups (GSMArena and PhoneArena), spots inflated list prices and filters fake reviews.
staticPages.aboutHeroDesc: Rate.vn was built to solve the 3 biggest problems of buying tech on online stores: vague or inconsistent specs across variants, list prices inflated before sale days to fake deep discounts, and thousands of fake or coin-farming reviews distorting star ratings.
staticPages.aboutPillarsTitle: Three Core Technical Pillars of Rate.vn
staticPages.aboutPillarsDescPrefix: All normalization and scoring algorithms are openly published in the
staticPages.aboutPillar1Title: 1. 10 spec groups and merging duplicate listings
staticPages.aboutPillar1Desc: Rate.vn automatically groups dozens of store listings for the same device into one product, using a normalized brand and model name, title similarity and AI that reads specs into the 10 GSMArena and PhoneArena groups.
staticPages.aboutPillar2Desc: Instead of trusting seller-entered "strikethrough prices", Rate.vn records real selling prices over time and compares the current price with the median of recorded prices to expose pre-sale price inflation.
staticPages.aboutPillar3Desc: AI sorts every review into one of 5 groups: authentic, coin-farming spam, paid fake review, competitor sabotage, or review bombing. Spam, fake, sabotage, bombing and shipping-only reviews do not count toward the product score. The rest start at weight 1.0 (0.25 when doubtful), gain weight with helpful votes and lose it for unhelpful votes or reports, up to 3.00x.
staticPages.aboutOpenCoreDesc: Seller trust scores and weighted product ratings are calculated automatically from the data, with formulas that are public on GitHub.
staticPages.aboutBullet1Desc: The data structure, scoring formulas and fake-discount detection are all public in the GitHub repository.
staticPages.aboutBullet2Desc: Sellers' private details are kept apart from the public data, so the website and the API cannot read them.
staticPages.aboutBullet3Desc: Provides an open JSON standard for browsers, the MV3 extension, and market researchers.
staticPages.aboutLinkFaq: Frequently Asked Questions on Scoring Methodology
staticPages.privacySeoDesc: How Rate.vn handles data: no account needed to browse, the comparison tray stays in your browser, review votes are tied to your DOS ID account, and sellers' private details are not public.
staticPages.privacyHeroDesc: You can look up specs, check product links, compare devices and see price history without giving any personal details.
staticPages.privacyS1Desc: When you browse products, paste a link to check or use the public Rate.vn API, you need no account and Rate.vn sets no third-party ad-tracking cookies.
staticPages.privacyS2Desc: Products you add to the comparison tray or the price watchlist are stored in your own browser, and your browser only sends read requests for public prices to keep the lowest price current. If you sign in and set a target price, Rate.vn saves that alert with your account so it can email you when the price drops.
staticPages.privacyS3Title: 3. Review votes are tied to an account
staticPages.privacyS3Desc: "Helpful" and "Report" need a signed-in DOS ID account (at least 7 days old, with a verified email or phone). Rate.vn stores the vote with your account ID so each account votes once per review, and it does not store your IP address.
staticPages.privacyS4Desc: A seller's private details (phone number, bank account) are kept in fields the public cannot read. The website and the API can only read the public fields.
staticPages.privacySide1Desc: The data access rules and how votes are stored are public in the GitHub repository.
staticPages.privacySide2Desc: If you own an Official Mall store and need to update store details or ask for your risk score to be reviewed again, please contact us through the Contact page.
staticPages.faqSeoTitle: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Methodology & Trust | Rate.vn
staticPages.faqSeoDesc: Answers on how Rate.vn standardizes 10 spec groups, weights review scores, spots fake discounts and scores seller risk.
staticPages.faqHeroSubtitle: How Rate.vn standardizes 10 technical spec groups, spots fake discounts and filters fake reviews.
staticPages.faqQ1: 1. How do Rate.vn's 10 spec groups differ from store listings?
staticPages.faqA1: On online stores, sellers enter specs in their own format or leave out key details such as the storage standard (UFS 4.0 or NVMe), peak brightness (nits) or real charging power. Rate.vn puts every product into 10 fixed groups (launch, body, display, platform, memory, cameras split per lens as on PhoneArena, audio, connectivity, battery, misc) checked against one shared format, so you can filter and compare precisely.
staticPages.faqQ2: 2. How does Rate.vn detect "Inflated Original Price Fake Discounts"?
staticPages.faqA2: Rate.vn never trusts seller-declared strikethrough prices when judging a deal. It records actual selling prices over time and compares the current price with the median of that offer's recent recorded prices (for an offer with fewer than two records, the higher of its own price and the median current price across sellers). If a seller inflates the list price to advertise 40-50% off while the actual price is not below the historical median, Rate.vn flags a fake discount.
staticPages.faqQ3: 3. How is the weighted review score calculated?
staticPages.faqA3: Unlike a plain average that is easy to game with 5-star coin-farming spam, Rate.vn weights each review. Coin-farming spam, paid fake reviews, competitor sabotage and review bombing get zero weight and do not count. Other reviews start at 1.0 (0.25 for star-only or doubtful reviews), gain weight logarithmically with net helpful votes and lose weight for unhelpful votes and reports, capped at 3.00x.
staticPages.faqQ4: 4. What goes into a seller's risk scores?
staticPages.faqA4: Every seller has 2 independent risk scores from 0 to 100: (1) scam risk, compared with the DOSafe scam alert list; (2) review risk, based on the share of fake reviews, a high share of genuine 1-2 star complaints and prices suspiciously below the standard model, and lower for official stores. Coin-farming comments and sabotage reviews from competitors are filtered out but do not raise the seller's risk. Trust score = 100 minus the highest risk score.
staticPages.faqQ5: 5. Can I check the link of any product?
staticPages.faqA5: Yes. In the home page search ("Check a link for fake sales and seller trust") or on the link checker page, paste a Shopee, Lazada or Tiki product or shop link to see its lowest recorded price, fake-discount warnings and the share of genuine reviews right away.
staticPages.faqQ6: 6. Where do the price watchlist and the comparison tray store my data?
staticPages.faqA6: Your price watchlist and comparison tray are stored in your own browser and refresh to the latest prices whenever you open the page, so no sign-in is required. If you sign in and set a target price, that alert is saved with your account so Rate.vn can email you.
staticPages.faqQ7: 7. Can developers access Rate.vn data via API?
staticPages.faqA7: Yes. Rate.vn has a public API at /api/v1/rate/* (with CORS and caching). You can read the documentation and run live queries on the developer page.

analyzerCopy.reasonAuthentic: Detailed, valid review from a real user.
analyzerCopy.reasonSabotage: Signs of unfair competition / steering buyers to another seller.
analyzerCopy.reasonBombing: Written without using the product or service (cancelled order or bandwagon).
analyzerCopy.reasonDuplicateSeeding: Fake-review template text duplicated across {count} different accounts.
analyzerCopy.reasonCopiedSeeding: Fake-review template copied or reworked across accounts ({pct}% structural similarity).
analyzerCopy.reasonRatingOnly: Stars only, no text: still counted, at a low weight (25% of a review with text).
analyzerCopy.reasonCoinSpam: Coin-farming comment or no real experience (left out of the overall score, no penalty for the shop).
analyzerCopy.reasonShippingOnly: Comments only on delivery or packaging (moved to the seller score, not counted for the product).
analyzerCopy.reasonContradiction: The star rating contradicts the comment (suspected wrong star or sarcasm, trust weight reduced).
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityDownvoted: Heavily voted down or reported by the community, so its weight was set to 0.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityPending: Community review awaiting analysis, not yet counted in the average.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityAccepted: Multi-criteria Rate.vn community review that meets the length and technical-detail bar.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityCoinSpam: Template coin-farming phrases detected, automatically left out of the JReviews average.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityAdLink: Advertising link or off-platform redirect detected, suspected fake review.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityCompetitor: Suspected redirect to a competitor without evidence of using the product.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityTooShort: Too short, not enough information to verify a real experience.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityCoinSpamExcluded: Template coin-farming phrases detected, left out of the average.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityAdLinkExcluded: Advertising link or off-platform redirect detected, left out of the average.
analyzerCopy.reasonCommunityCompetitorExcluded: Suspected redirect to a competitor, left out of the average.
